lesson_fields.title: Current, Voltage and Resistance
lesson_fields.summary: Current is the flow of charge. Voltage drives the current and resistance opposes it. Ohm's law links the three.
lesson_fields.summary_fr: Le courant est un ecoulement de charge. La tension fait circuler le courant et la resistance s'y oppose. La loi d'Ohm relie les trois.
lesson_fields.content:
## Current and voltage

Current is the rate of flow of charge, measured in amperes. Voltage is the energy given to each charge, measured in volts. Resistance opposes the current, measured in ohms.

## Ohm's law

Voltage equals current times resistance. If resistance rises with voltage unchanged, current falls.
lesson_fields.content_fr:
## Courant et tension

Le courant est le debit de charge, mesure en ampere. La tension est l'energie fournie a chaque charge, mesure en volt. La resistance s'oppose au courant, mesuree en ohm.

## La loi d'Ohm

La tension egale le courant fois la resistance. Si la resistance augmente a tension constante, le courant diminue.
objectives: Explain how changing resistance affects current
objectives_fr: Expliquer comment la resistance modifie le courant

steps.title: Current and charge
steps.content: Current is the flow of electric charge. It is measured in amperes with an ammeter connected in series. In a simple circuit, current is the same all around.
steps.content_fr: Le courant est l'ecoulement de charge electrique. Il se mesure en ampere avec un amperemetre branche en serie. Dans un circuit simple, le courant est le meme partout.

steps.title: Voltage and resistance
steps.content: Voltage is the energy transferred per unit charge, measured with a voltmeter in parallel. Resistance is how much a component opposes the current, measured in ohms.
steps.content_fr: La tension est l'energie transferee par unite de charge, mesuree au voltmetre en derivation. La resistance est la mesure de l'opposition d'un composant au courant, en ohms.

steps.title: Using Ohm's law
steps.content: If a resistor has 6 ohms and the current is 2 amperes, the voltage is 6 times 2, which is 12 volts.
steps.content_fr: Si une resistance vaut 6 ohms et que le courant est de 2 amperes, la tension vaut 6 fois 2, soit 12 volts.

steps.title: Your turn: find resistance
steps.content: A voltage of 12 volts drives a current of 3 amperes. What is the resistance, in ohms?
steps.content_fr: Une tension de 12 volts envoie un courant de 3 amperes. Quelle est la resistance, en ohms ?

question.explanation: Resistance equals voltage divided by current: 12 divided by 3 is 4 ohms.
question.explanation_fr: La resistance egale la tension divisee par le courant : 12 divise par 3 vaut 4 ohms.

steps.title: Check: changing resistance
steps.content: With the voltage fixed, increasing the resistance reduces the current. This is why a variable resistor dims a lamp.
steps.content_fr: A tension fixe, augmenter la resistance reduit le courant. C'est pourquoi un rhéostat attenue une lampe.

question.text: With fixed voltage, what happens if resistance increases?
question.text_fr: A tension fixe, que se passe-t-il si la resistance augmente ?

hints.text_fr: Plus d'opposition signifie moins de debit.

steps.title: What to keep
steps.content: Current is the flow of charge in amperes, voltage drives it in volts, and resistance opposes it in ohms. Ohm's law: voltage equals current times resistance.
steps.content_fr: Le courant est l'ecoulement de charge en ampere, la tension l'entraine en volts, et la resistance s'y oppose en ohms. Loi d'Ohm : tension egale courant fois resistance.
